dashboard.summaryZh: 管理数据集、结构化表格和可复用的数据输入。
dashboard.summaryEn: Manage datasets, structured tables, and reusable data inputs.
handoffZh: 结构化数据集可以直接送入工作流作为输入。
支持空间格式的数据版本可以继续进入地图与叠加层流程。
handoffEn: Structured datasets can flow directly into workflows as inputs.
Spatial-ready dataset versions can continue into map and overlay flows.

dashboard.summaryZh: 查看产品资料、三维预览与可公开展示的产品资产。
dashboard.summaryEn: Browse product records, 3D previews, and publishable showcase assets.
handoffZh: 公开产品可以继续作为对外展示资产复用。
产品文件与元数据仍然回流到资产中心统一管理。
handoffEn: Published products remain reusable as showcase assets.
Product files and metadata should still flow back to the asset hub.

dashboard.summaryZh: 可视化地图叠加层、ROI 与空间分析结果。
dashboard.summaryEn: Visualize map overlays, ROIs, and spatial analysis outputs.
handoffZh: 符合 overlay 输入结构的工作流输出应当可以直接在地图中打开。
保存的 ROI 可以继续送入工作流作为空间输入。
handoffEn: Workflow outputs that match the overlay contract should open directly on the map.
Saved ROIs can feed workflows as spatial inputs.

dashboard.summaryZh: 编排数据处理、模型推理与结果产出链路。
dashboard.summaryEn: Compose data preparation, model inference, and result delivery chains.
handoffZh: 数据集、ROI、模型和个人凭证都应该能直接送入工作流。
符合条件的工作流输出应当能直接回流到地图或资产中心。
handoffEn: Datasets, ROIs, models, and personal credentials should all feed workflows.
Qualified workflow outputs should hand off directly to maps or the asset hub.

dashboard.summaryZh: 管理模型版本、训练产物和外部 API 模型配置。
dashboard.summaryEn: Inspect model versions, training artifacts, and external API model configs.
handoffZh: 模型版本应该能够直接进入工作流推理节点。
训练输出应该回流为可复用的模型资产。
handoffEn: Model versions should feed workflow inference nodes directly.
Training outputs should flow back into reusable model assets.

dashboard.summaryZh: 管理个人资料、安全设置与账号申请。
dashboard.summaryEn: Manage profile, security settings, and access requests.
handoffZh: 账号资料应与可复用资产保持边界清晰，不再混在同一入口。
角色申请与安全设置应直接反馈到账户状态与可见权限。
handoffEn: Account information should stay clearly separated from reusable assets.
Access requests and security changes should feed back into account state and permissions.

dashboard.summaryZh: 管理可复用输入、流程结果、共享能力与发布状态。
dashboard.summaryEn: Manage reusable inputs, workflow outputs, shared capabilities, and publication state.
handoffZh: 资产中心应该明确展示每项资产下一步还能送到哪里。
工作流、地图和模型产出的资产，以及 GEE 凭证这类共享能力，都应统一回流到这里。
handoffEn: The asset hub should clearly show what each asset can feed next.
Assets produced by workflows, maps, and models, plus shared capabilities such as GEE credentials, should flow back here.

dashboard.summaryZh: 处理账号审批、角色变更与治理动作。
dashboard.summaryEn: Review account approvals, role changes, and governance actions.
handoffZh: 审批结果应直接影响首页可见模块与入口状态。
治理动作完成后也应回写到总览状态。
handoffEn: Approval outcomes should change visible modules and entry points on the overview.
Governance actions should also flow back into overview state.

dashboard.summaryZh: 维护首页公告、平台邮件和工作空间级配置。
dashboard.summaryEn: Maintain overview announcements, platform email, and workspace-level settings.
handoffZh: 公告内容应直接进入总览首页，不再和功能介绍重复堆叠。
系统级配置应继续与账号页、资产页保持边界清晰。
handoffEn: Announcement content should feed the overview directly instead of duplicating feature copy.
System settings should stay clearly separated from account and asset pages.
